hypotheses.text: Mutations in the Kelch13 propeller domain, similar to those seen in P. falciparum, drive artemisinin resistance in P. knowlesi by lowering ring-stage drug susceptibility.

claims.text: Kelch13 propeller-domain mutations are associated with reduced artemisinin susceptibility.

references.raw: Ariey F, et al. A molecular marker of artemisinin-resistant Plasmodium falciparum malaria. Nature 2014.

hypotheses.text: Changes in parasite plasma membrane lipid composition influence ring-stage drug tolerance, separately from Kelch13 mutation status.

claims.text: Membrane lipid remodelling during the ring stage alters permeability to artemisinin derivatives.

hypotheses.text: The parasite's preference for reticulocytes affects recrudescence patterns after artemisinin combination therapy, regardless of resistance mutations.

claims.text: Reticulocyte tropism creates a niche with different drug exposure dynamics.
